To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of interesting examples increased attention, interest, and reading speed, and that the use of familiar topics increased comprehension, interest, and topic familiarity.

(a) the use of interesting examples increased attention, comprehension, and reading speed, (b) topic familiarity increased comprehension, reading time, and reported interest in the topic, (c) interesting examples increased reading speed and topic familiarity increased reading time.

(1) the use of interesting examples in text improves comprehension, attention, and reading speed; (2) the effect of interestingness on comprehension, reading speed and attention is greater for unfamiliar topics than for familiar topics; (3) the use of generic examples in text does not improve reading speed, comprehension, or attention; (4) topic familiarity increases comprehension, attention, reading speed and reported interest in the topic.

the effects of interesting examples and topic familiarity on text comprehension, attention, and reading speed.
